Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final conclusion. After correctly gathering that "Aami" was released in 2018 and "Bitch Slap" was released in 2009, the Planner incorrectly stated that "Bitch Slap was released more recently." In reality, 2018 is more recent than 2009, so "Aami" should have been the correct answer. The Planner failed to perform the basic comparison of the years it had just retrieved.
